'''Imperial records''' was the database of historical and contemporary intelligence on matters pertaining to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They included information on the founding of the Empire and a [[Recruitment database]]. Portions of Imperial records were [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] into and stolen by [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
